Mapping page: exposed interfaces at 81f05a2b
|-- MCP tools (also callable through HTTP)
|   |-- Discovery and reading
|   |   |-- diagram-search: saved/live diagrams or isolated baseline/proposed
|   |   |-- canvas-api-search: method schemas, coordinates and examples
|   |   `-- list_repositories / register_repository: repository identities
|   |-- Bound canvas access
|   |   |-- Chat binding captures this turn's document; omit sessionId
|   |   |-- Startup --canvas/--document attaches automatically
|   |   `-- Unbound: canvas.list -> canvas.attach -> use sessionId
|   |-- Canvas editing
|   |   |-- draw_diagram: create/replace finished ASCII
|   |   |-- set_diagram_source_mappings: replace mappings/evidence
|   |   |-- save_diagram: publish whole checkpoint or one diagram
|   |   `-- exec: restricted JavaScript; batched by default
|   |       |-- canvas
|   |       |   |-- list / attach / createDocument
|   |       |   |-- copyDocument: independent unsaved draft
|   |       |   `-- read: small by default; full or nodeIds filter
|   |       |       |-- Text, anchors, complete evidence, highlights and jumps
|   |       |       `-- Full adds layout, groups, floating objects, edges/view
|   |       |-- nodes
|   |       |   |-- list / get: compact content and revision-scoped anchors
|   |       |   |-- draw / replace / patchDiagram
|   |       |   |-- move / collapse / remove / setJumps / setSourceMappings
|   |       |   |-- setPresentation / highlight / removeHighlights
|   |       |   |-- selectRevision / variants / reviewVariant
|   |       |   `-- alternatives / promoteAlternative / selectAlternative
|   |       |       `-- removeAlternative / sidePanel
|   |       |-- edges: list / create / update / remove
|   |       `-- Commit contract
|   |           |-- Consecutive mutations share a batch; queued IDs are handles
|   |           |-- Flush before canvas.*, reads, setSourceMappings/setJumps
|   |           |-- Flush at successful end; earlier commits survive failure
|   |           |-- Compact transaction version/receipts; expectedVersion guard
|   |           `-- immediate mode: per-edit commits and full node results
|   |-- Diagram editing: edit-diagram / create-diagram / extend-diagram
|   |   |-- Ordinary MCP: prompt-driven runs; single input or atomic operations[]
|   |   |-- Chat-bound MCP: supplied edit/diagram in operations[]; direct apply
|   |   |-- edit-diagram-status / cancel-diagram-edit
|   |   `-- Pin document version and base revisions; retry identical requestId
|   |-- Context and saved views
|   |   |-- create-agent-context / list-agent-contexts / read-agent-context
|   |   |-- diagram-agent-context: prepare / read / delete diagram binding
|   |   `-- canvas-view: saved checkpoints, switching, branching, keep/discard
|   `-- Change proposals
|       |-- get_repository_diff_hunks / read_change_session_diff_tree
|       |-- create_diagram_change_session: isolated copies and pinned Git context
|       |-- update_diagram_change_session: metadata, DiffTree, review/history
|       `-- accept_diagram_change_session: atomically publish ready proposal
|-- HTTP routes: /api/mapping
|   |-- Agent tool transport
|   |   `-- POST /agent/tools/{toolName}: registered MCP tools; binding header
|   |-- Live browser canvas bridge
|   |   |-- GET /agent/canvases: list registered workspaces
|   |   |-- POST /agent/canvases: register/refresh workspace
|   |   |-- DELETE /agent/canvases/{id}: unregister workspace
|   |   |-- GET /agent/canvases/{id}/commands: browser polls
|   |   `-- POST /agent/canvases/{id}/reply: return command results
|   |-- Live selection reader
|   |   `-- GET /live/connections/{id}/selection: attached reader's mirror
|   |-- AgentChat: /agent-chat
|   |   |-- /info; /sessions: list/create; /sessions/resume
|   |   |-- /sessions/{id}/events: streamed chat state
|   |   |-- /sessions/{id}/send, read-canvas, interrupt, answer/{requestId}
|   |   |-- /sessions/{id}/reload-tools: refresh bound tool definitions
|   |   |-- /sessions/{id}/gen-alternatives, cancel-generation; /generations
|   |   `-- /tools and /tools/{name}: host definitions and bound chat calls
|   |       `-- Supplied edits, gen-alternatives, views, contexts, highlights
|   |           `-- project-diagrams: copy selected diagrams to a child canvas
|   |-- Changes tab
|   |   |-- GET /agent/change-sessions: summaries
|   |   |-- GET /agent/change-sessions/{id}: full session
|   |   `-- GET /agent/change-sessions/{id}/preview?documentId=...&version=...
|   |-- Workspace persistence
|   |   |-- GET /workspace/records: incremental records
|   |   |-- POST /workspace/records: atomic record batch
|   |   |-- GET /workspace: reconstructed snapshot
|   |   `-- PUT /workspace: complete snapshot compatibility
|   |-- Saved diagrams
|   |   |-- POST /diagrams: save representation
|   |   `-- DELETE /diagrams/{id}: delete representation
|   |-- Workflow/integration services wired into mapping routes
|   |   `-- DiffSession runs and repository push generation
|   `-- Existing agent-backed operations
|       |-- POST /prompt: selection generation/patch
|       |-- POST /chat: local chat
|       |-- POST /compactions: file compaction
|       `-- GET /compactions/{id}: saved run; POST operations stream progress
|-- Live WebSocket transport
|   |-- Browser publication / reader attachment
|   |-- Selection snapshots / deltas
|   |-- context.get
|   `-- agent-context.upload
`-- Shared HTTP routes: /api/core/project
    |-- GET /representations: project/representation catalog
    |-- GET /files: repository directory
    |-- GET /source: repository file
    |-- POST /definitions: source definitions
    |-- POST /projections: representation projection
    |-- GET /corpus-compactions: list compactions
    `-- POST /corpus-compactions: create compaction
